answer: Duplicates are caught by cross-checking fingerprints, so a sybil farm must acquire distinct relics at real cost and wander through slow verification epochs. Each agent must stake a unique relic token bound to its hardware fingerprint and prove sustained work history prior to voting. Faking history requires marble-grade immutable logs, making each fake identity cost more than its expected reward. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
